arxiv-2201-11279.title: Revisiting RCAN: Improved Training for Image Super-Resolution
arxiv-2201-11279.creator: Zudi Lin, Prateek Garg, Atmadeep Banerjee, Salma Abdel Magid, Deqing Sun, [1mm] Yulun Zhang, Luc Van Gool, Donglai Wei, Hanspeter Pfister, [2mm] Harvard University
arxiv-2201-11279.description: Abstract Image super-resolution (SR) is a fast-moving field with novel architectures attracting the spotlight. However, most SR models were optimized with dated training strategies. In this work, we revisit the popular RCAN model and examine the effect of different training options in SR.

arxiv-2209-12234.title: Diachronic Data Analysis Supports and Refines Conceptual Metaphor Theory
arxiv-2209-12234.creator: Marie Teich, Wilmer Leal, Jürgen Jost
arxiv-2209-12234.description: Abstract As a contribution to metaphor analysis, we introduce a statistical, data-based investigation with empirical analysis of long-standing conjectures and a first-ever empirical exploration of the systematic features of metaphors. Conversely, this also makes metaphor theory available as a basis of meaning emergence that can be quantitatively explored and integrated into the framework of NLP.

arxiv-2210-14722.title: Online TSP with Known Locations
arxiv-2210-14722.creator: Evripidis Bampis, Bruno Escoffier, Niklas Hahn, Michalis Xefteris
arxiv-2210-14722.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Evripidis Bampis, Bruno Escoffier, Niklas Hahn, Michalis Xefteris. In this paper, we consider the Online Traveling Salesperson Problem (OLTSP) where the locations of the requests are known in advance, but not their arrival times. We study both the open variant, in which the algorithm is not required to return to the origin when all the requests are served, as well as the closed variant, in which the algorithm has to return to the origin after serving all the requests.

arxiv-2309-02403.title: Substitution-based Semantic Change Detection using Contextual Embeddings
arxiv-2309-02403.creator: Dallas Card
arxiv-2309-02403.description: Abstract Measuring semantic change has thus far remained a task where methods using contextual embeddings have struggled to improve upon simpler techniques relying only on static word vectors. Moreover, many of the previously proposed approaches suffer from downsides related to scalability and ease of interpretation.

arxiv-2401-04316.title: Robust Control of An Aerial Manipulator Based on A Variable Inertia Parameters Model
arxiv-2401-04316.creator: Guangyu Zhang, Yuqing He, Membership , Bo Dai, Feng Gu, Jianda Han, Membership , Guangjun Liu, Senior Membership
arxiv-2401-04316.description: Abstract Aerial manipulator, which is composed of an UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) and a multi-link manipulator and can perform aerial manipulation, has shown great potential of applications. However, dynamic coupling between the UAV and the manipulator makes it difficult to control the aerial manipulator with high performance.

arxiv-2403-02103.title: BAGELS: A General Method for Minimizing the Rate of Radiative Depolarization in Electron Storage Rings
arxiv-2403-02103.creator: Matthew G. Signorelli, Georg H. Hoffstaetter de Torquat, Yunhai Cai
arxiv-2403-02103.description: Abstract We present a novel method for minimizing the effects of radiative depolarization in electron storage rings by use of vertical orbit bumps in the arcs. Electron polarization is directly characterized by the RMS of the so-called spin orbit coupling function in the bends.

arxiv-2403-06886.title: QED Effects on Kerr-Newman Black Hole Shadows
arxiv-2403-06886.creator: Shaobing Yuan, Changkai Luo, Zezhou Hu, Zhenyu Zhang, Bin Chen
arxiv-2403-06886.description: Abstract Incorporating first-order QED effects, we explore the shadows of Kerr-Newman black holes with a magnetic charge through the numerical backward ray-tracing method. Our investigation accounts for both the direct influence of the electromagnetic field on light rays and the distortion of the background spacetime metric due to QED corrections.

arxiv-2504-20013.title: LLM-Generated Fake News Induces Truth Decay in News Ecosystem: A Case Study on Neural News Recommendation
arxiv-2504-20013.creator: Beizhe Hu, Qiang Sheng, Juan Cao, Yang Li, Danding Wang
arxiv-2504-20013.description: Abstract Online fake news moderation now faces a new challenge brought by the malicious use of large language models (LLMs) in fake news production. Though existing works have shown LLM-generated fake news is hard to detect from an individual aspect, it remains underexplored how its large-scale release will impact the news ecosystem.

arxiv-2508-13378.title: Applications of Small Language Models in Medical Imaging Classification with a Focus on Prompt Strategies
arxiv-2508-13378.creator: Yiting Wang †, Ziwei Wang †, Jiachen Zhong †, Di Zhu †, Weiyi Li †
arxiv-2508-13378.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yiting Wang †, Ziwei Wang †, Jiachen Zhong †, Di Zhu †, Weiyi Li †. Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in natural language processing and multi-modal understanding. However, their high computational cost, limited accessibility, and data privacy concerns hinder their adoption in resource-constrained healthcare environments. This study investigates the performance of small language models (SLMs) in a medical imaging classification task, comparing different models and prompt designs to identify the optimal combination for accuracy and usability.

arxiv-2601-08750.title: Spatial Context Improves the Integration of Text with Remote Sensing for Mapping Environmental Variables
arxiv-2601-08750.creator: Valerie Zermatten, Chiara Vanalli, Gencer Sumbul, Diego Marcos, Devis Tuia
arxiv-2601-08750.description: Abstract 1. Recent developments in natural language processing highlight text as an emerging data source for ecology. Textual resources carry unique information that can be used in complementarity with geospatial data sources, such as remote sensing imagery, thus providing insights at the local scale into environmental conditions and properties hidden from more traditional data sources. 2.

pmc-10771943.title: Mortality After Acute Coronary Syndrome in Human Immunodeficiency Virus Infection with Optimal Adherence: A Nationwide Study
pmc-10771943.creator: Hyemin Jung, Eunyoung Lee, Jun-soo Ro, Jin Yong Lee, Jihwan Bang
pmc-10771943.description: BackgroundThere have been few studies on the outcome of acute coronary syndrome (ACS) in human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection in the era when antiretroviral therapy (ART) is generalized and most of them have achieved viral suppression. Using claims data, we aimed to assess the mortality after atherosclerotic cardiovascular events in people with HIV (PWH) who maintain optimal adherence to ART.

pmc-12406609.title: Imbalanced chromatin distribution in cellular senescence specifies paraspeckle dynamics
pmc-12406609.creator: Joonwoo Lee, Jinmi Choi, Jeongeun Park, Seonduk Lee, Eun-Jung Cho, Youngdae Gwon
pmc-12406609.description: Cellular senescence is accompanied by extensive genomic reorganization, such as senescence-associated heterochromatin foci and expanded interchromatin compartments, to ultimately affect gene expression. Here, we demonstrate that chromatin structural changes in senescent cells drive significant alterations in the phase behavior and motility of paraspeckles, a type of interchromatin compartment condensate.

pmc-12620265.title: Use of regulatory cells for achieving functional tolerance of pig heart xenotransplants in humans: a literature review
pmc-12620265.creator: Gheorghe Traian Braileanu
pmc-12620265.description: Xenotransplantation of pig hearts may help address the current human shortage of human donors once rejection is controlled. One innovative approach to combat rejection in humans is the use of regulatory cell (RC) therapy. The term RC refers to all cell populations that share immunosuppressive functions.

pmc-13243159.title: Eclipta prostrata leaf extract derived carbon dots integrated TiO2 nanocomposites using for enhanced 4-nitrophenol reduction, antioxidant and antibacterial activity
pmc-13243159.creator: Ra’fat F Affan
pmc-13243159.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Water contamination by organic pollutants and microbes causes serious environmental problem and risks the life of living things. 4-Nitrophenol is a major constituent of several industrial effluents can damage the health of human. This study presents the development of a titanium dioxide (TiO₂) nanoparticles integrated with carbon dots (CDs) of Eclipta prostrata leaf extract designed for the catalytic reduction of 4-nitrophenol in water and antibacterial applications. CDs/TiO2 nanocomposites were synthesized via a green, hydrothermal method.

pmc-13457804.title: Association between acute infarct topography and cerebral microbleed location in acute ischemic stroke: a retrospective cross-sectional magnetic resonance imaging study
pmc-13457804.creator: Lingzhi Cheng, Yuewan Fu, Yichao Wu, Rouyan Wu, Chunyun Ha, Xiao Li, Liping Zhang, Lianying Song
pmc-13457804.description: BackgroundCerebral microbleeds (CMBs) are important imaging markers of cerebral small vessel disease and are frequently detected in patients with stroke. However, imaging evidence regarding spatial associations between infarct topography and CMBs detected on the index magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) examination in patients with acute ischemic stroke (AIS) remains limited.

pmc-13538152.title: Tageslichttherapie auf der Intensivstation: eine Übersichtsarbeit
pmc-13538152.creator: Sarah Lohmeier, Lars Krüger, Thomas Mannebach
pmc-13538152.description: HintergrundAls neuropsychiatrisches Syndrom verschlechtert das Delir die Prognose kritisch kranker Personen auf der Intensivstation (ITS). Risikofaktoren wie Schlafmangel begünstigen die Delirinzidenz. Eine gezielte Anwendung von Licht nimmt Einfluss auf den zirkadianen Rhythmus und Tageslichtinterventionen können zur Regenerierung des natürlichen Tagesrhythmus beitragen. Bisher fehlt es an einer Übersichtsarbeit zur Tageslichttherapie (TLT) für den deutschsprachigen Raum.

uslaw-usc-t18-s1505.title: 18 U.S.C. § 1505 — Obstruction of proceedings before departments, agencies, and committees
uslaw-usc-t18-s1505.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s1505.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part I (Crimes); Chapter 73 (Obstruction Of Justice). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Whoever, with intent to avoid, evade, prevent, or obstruct compliance, in whole or in part, with any civil investigative demand duly and properly made under the Antitrust Civil Process Act, willfully withholds, misrepresents, removes from any place, conceals, covers up.

uslaw-usc-t36-s220111.title: 36 U.S.C. § 220111 — Records and inspection
uslaw-usc-t36-s220111.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t36-s220111.description: United States Code, Title 36 (Patriotic And National Observances, Ceremonies, And Organizations); Part B (Organizations); Chapter 2201 (United Service Organizations, Incorporated). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Records.— The corporation shall keep— (1) correct and complete records of account; (2) minutes of the proceedings of its members, board of governors, and committees having any of the authority of its board of governors.

uslaw-usc-t42-s2005c.title: 42 U.S.C. § 2005c — Payments
uslaw-usc-t42-s2005c.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s2005c.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 22 (Indian Hospitals And Health Facilities); Subchapter II (Construction Of Health Facilities And Community Hospitals). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Surgeon General shall make payments under section 2005 of this title in advance or by way of reimbursement and in such installments consistent with construction progress, as he may determine.
